title: Install Planning JHA
markdown:
# PV102 Day 7: Installation Planning Mechanical Layout and JHA

Students plan an installation before touching hardware: layout, material staging, wire routes, access, roof or ground hazards, tool control, quality checks, and job hazard analysis.

PV102 | CTS Day 23 | Instructor Run Sheet

Plan the install before lifting parts. | Wednesday, August 12, 2026

# Core rule

Plan the install before lifting parts.

# Learning targets

Convert a design into a sequenced work plan.

Identify mechanical, electrical, fall, weather, access, and tool hazards.

Build a material/tool list that matches the scope.

Use checklists to prevent skipped steps and hidden coupling.

# Readiness and materials

| Before students arrive | Materials |
| --- | --- |
| Open slide deck and test display. Print student packets and one instructor key. Prepare three team stations. Review safety boundary before any equipment is handled. | Mock roof or tabletop layout ; Rail/bracket cards or hardware ; JHA template ; Tool cards ; Tape measure ; Markers ; Projector and slide deck |

# Five-hour run of show

| Time | Block | Instructor move |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 10:00-10:15 | Opening and continuity | Connect Day 6 to today's rule. Name what students already know and what new judgment is being added. |
| 10:15-10:40 | Morning quiz and review | Students work independently for 12-15 minutes. Review by asking for evidence, not just letters. |
| 10:40-11:25 | Concept lesson | Use slides 1-14. Pause after each technical rule and ask what decision it changes. |
| 11:25-12:15 | Guided practice | Model one example on the board. Students complete a quick pair-check before lunch. |
| 12:15-12:45 | Lunch/reset | Reset lab stations. Keep energized work out of scope unless explicitly authorized by instructor and equipment procedure. |
| 12:45-1:00 | Lab brief | Assign teams and roles. Review acceptance criteria and stop-work triggers. |
| 1:00-2:15 | Install Plan and Job Hazard Analysis | Teams create a one-day install plan for a training system and defend the safety controls before work begins. |
| 2:15-2:40 | Handoffs and peer verification | Each team gives a concise technical handoff. Peers check evidence, boundary, and unknowns. |
| 2:40-3:00 | Exit ticket and reset | Collect packets. Preview next step: PV102 Day 8 uses commissioning and troubleshooting to verify the system and complete a professional handoff. |

# Instructor talk track

Opening script: "PV102 is not about throwing parts at a problem until reality files a complaint. Today we use installation planning mechanical layout and jha to make the next design decision safer and more defensible. The rule is simple: Plan the install before lifting parts."

# Teaching notes

| Move | Look-for |
| --- | --- |
| Ask | What decision does this evidence change? |
| Listen for | Students separating facts, assumptions, and unknowns. |
| Correct gently | Component-first answers. Redirect to job, evidence, boundary, then component. |
| Require | A handoff that another person could act on without reading minds. Humanity keeps trying telepathy. It remains a poor project-management system. |

# Lab instructor procedure

Choose a scenario and define the scope in one sentence.

Create a sequenced work plan: setup, layout, mounting/staging, wiring route, checks, cleanup.

Complete a JHA with hazards, controls, PPE, and stop-work triggers.

Build a material/tool list and mark missing items.

Add at least three quality hold points.

Handoff the plan as if a substitute crew had to run it safely.

# Answer snapshot and contingency plan

If equipment or printing is unavailable, run the lab with paper cards, chart paper, and oral handoffs. The learning target is decision quality, not hardware theater.

# Safety and scope boundaries

No live electrical work is authorized by this lesson unless the instructor independently sets up a verified training system, follows manufacturer instructions, and establishes the required isolation, PPE, and supervision. Treat PV source circuits and batteries as energy sources, not props.

# Day handoff

PV102 Day 8 uses commissioning and troubleshooting to verify the system and complete a professional handoff.
